utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts this afternoon, around three.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do I need to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might need that help more than I thought.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course, Noah. Tell me what you need and I’ll bring the right tools over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam again. Folks around here have been talking about dropping off supplies this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, but I’d want to know where people should park and what still needs to be dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around for the parking details and what supplies they still need, so folks can show up ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s the hallway light by the stairs and the loose latch on the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll head over and check both, then report back what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, come by later and I’ll pass along the details about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll stop by later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep an ear out for you when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ll get the repair drive organized and make sure we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Let me know what I should bring or fix next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo. Could you handle any loose wiring or broken fixtures you spot, and I’ll keep the list updated with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the loose porch railing and the leak under the kitchen sink. I can help after dinner.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I can help with the porch railing and the kitchen sink leak after dinner.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive after school pickup if you send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send them over and I’ll take it from there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard bits about the repair drive. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly quiet so far, but they’ve got a repair list going and could use another pair of hands if you’re interested.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds worth checking out, though I only caught the gist. Is there a spot where they want help most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in, just point me to what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure you can handle whatever turns up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m sure enough. Point me at the worst of it and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that’d be a big help. I might need a little reminding while we’re at it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can keep you on track.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll tell folks and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure we don’t come up short.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll spread the word and keep checking in so the plan stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along; I can swing by after errands and drop off anything you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I still need a few screws and some wood glue if you can drop those off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, I’ll bring those by after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was just about to ask you if you needed me to bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, if you could bring a few boxes of packing tape and some zip ties, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, I can grab those on my way over. I’ll bring a few boxes of packing tape and some zip ties.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think Leo mentioned it earlier, but I missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s a repair drive for the block. I can send the details again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. I’ve got some tools I can lend if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Gus. I’ll stop by with a short list so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli. Bring the list by and I’ll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs sorting, and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you. I still need someone to round up tools, and I’m going to start inviting a few more neighbors so we can split the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot. I’ll take care of rounding up the tools while you invite the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you want. I know a few folks who’d show up for this.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, that’d help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the sign-up sheet ready, and I’m checking in with everyone this afternoon so we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with supplies after your check-ins, Rosa. Tell me what still needs to be rounded up and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll send you the list after I finish my check-ins, and we can make sure the right supplies are covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s moving ahead, but I’m still getting the updates secondhand. How’s it going from your side?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s moving, but I’m still waiting on the latest schedule. Once I get it, I’ll pass it along directly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll wait for your direct update when you get the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you take a look at the roof tiles and the front fence? I need to line up the repairs around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can do that. I’ll look at both and line up the timing around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm exactly what part of the repair drive you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I need help loading and unloading the donated supplies for the repair drive, and maybe organizing them by room.
